item.title: 05627Y0269-Barnacle Vehicle Immobilization devices
item.description:
Police Department | Procurement | Intent to Award | Due: 2026-11-19 In plain English (machine-written): The New York City Police Department intends to negotiate a sole source five-year lease of Barnacle vehicle immobilization devices with ITSA Solutions, LLC, with three three-year renewal options, and other vendors may respond by Nov. 19, 2026.

Pursuant to Section 3-05 of the NYC Procurement Policy Board Rules, it is the intent of the New York City Police Department (NYPD) to enter into sole source negotiations with ITSA Solutions, LLC d/b/a Barnacle Parking Enforcement with the expectation that ITSA Solutions, LLC will be awarded a five year contract with three, 3-Year renewal options for the Lease of Barnacle Vehicle Immobilization devices. The basis of this determination is that ITSA Solutions, LLC is the sole provider and uniquely qualified to provide these specialized services for NYPDs Traffic Enforcement Division and other Bureaus. Any vendor besides ITSA Solutions, LLC that believes it can provide these services is invited to do so.  To respond in PASSPort, please upload an Expression of Interest in the Documents Submission Section of the Manage Responses tab.  If you have questions about the details of the RFx, please submit them through the Discussion with Buyer tab.

item.title: Nicolet Apex FTIR Spectrometers
item.description:
Police Department | Procurement | Intent to Award | Due: 2026-11-04 In plain English (machine-written): The New York City Police Department intends to negotiate a sole source contract with Fisher Scientific Company LLC (Thermo Fisher) to buy eight Nicolet Apex FTIR Spectrometers, instruments used to analyze cocaine caseload and training samples, with responses due Nov. 4, 2026.

Pursuant to Section 3-05 of the NYC Procurement Policy Board Rules, it is the intent of the New York City Police Department (NYPD) to enter into sole source negotiations with Fisher Scientific Company LLC (Thermo Fisher) with the expectation that the vendor will be awarded a contract with the NYPD to provide eight (8) brand-specific Nicolet Apex Transform Infrared Spectrometers (Apex FTIR Spectrometer).

The contract will provide for the manufacture and delivery of eight Apex FTIR Spectrometers.  This instruments will be utilized to analyze the cocaine caseload and training samples

Thermo Fisher is the sole manufacturer of Nicolet Apex FTIR Spectrometers. These instruments are proprietary equipment and Thermo Fisher owns the copyrights to its design specifications. The NYPD is of the belief that because the instrument is proprietary and copyrighted, Thermo Fisher is the only vendor legally authorized to provide this specialized item.

item.title: Rigaku XRD Instrument
item.description:
Police Department | Procurement | Intent to Award | Due: 2026-11-04 In plain English (machine-written): The NYPD intends to negotiate a sole-source contract with Rigaku Americas to buy one Rigaku MiniFlex 6G X-ray diffraction instrument for its Police Laboratory's Criminalistics Section, which uses it to analyze tape, chemical unknowns and explosives, with responses due Nov. 4, 2026.

Pursuant to Section 3-05 of the NYC Procurement Policy Board Rules, it is the intent of the New York City Police Department (NYPD) to enter into sole source negotiations with Rigaku Americas with the expectation that the vendor will be awarded a contract with the NYPD to provide one brand-specific Rigaku MiniFlex 6G Benchtop X-Ray Diffraction (XRD) Instrument (XRD Instrument).

The contract will provide for the manufacture and delivery of one XRD Instrument. This instrument will be used by the Criminalistics Section of the Police Laboratory to analyze, compare, and identify components in tape, chemical unknowns and explosives

Rigaku Americas is the sole manufacturer of the MiniFlex XRD Instrument. These instruments are proprietary equipment and Rigaku Americas owns the copyrights to its design specifications. The NYPD is of the belief that because the instrument is proprietary and copyrighted, Rigaku Americas is the only vendor legally authorized to provide this specialized item.

item.title: Training for Forensic Interviewing
item.description:
Police Department | Procurement | Award | $214K | Vendor: National Children's Advocacy Center In plain English (machine-written): The New York Police Department renewed its contract with the National Children's Advocacy Center for $213,940 to provide training in forensic interviewing of children and adolescents in abuse, neglect and witness cases.

The training is designed for child interviewers who have responsibility for initial investigative/forensic interviews of children and adolescents in cases where there are allegations of sexual or physical abuse, neglect, or in cases where a child is a witness to a crime.
